description: Three-way merge of branch `head` into its parent `base` using the recorded fork base. Without `apply` this is a dry run returning the plan and conflicts; with `apply` a clean plan is applied. Conflicting plans need a forced merge from the console. POST /v1/organizations/{id}/projects/{project}/branches/merge.

apply.description: Apply a clean plan instead of a dry run (default false)

confirm.description: Must be true to apply this mutation; otherwise the tool returns the request it would send for approval.

name: branch.merge
